title: A game family's descriptor (families/<id>.json, read by game.catalog)
description: Data about one family of games: what its board shows, how it is played, which meta actions exist and which policies its code offers. English; never names a site or an app. The text is context data for perception, not a prompt; the rules themselves are the family's code.

revision.description: the rule revision plans and estimates are pinned to

state_schema.description: the state shape the family's core reads and writes

state_fields.description: each field of the state the family's code reads and writes, with what its values mean: how a cell or piece is written, which value marks one nobody read (what a correction may fill) and which values look empty but are not unread

button_on.description: the scene whose own message shows the button this meta action presses (a win message's "keep going"): pressed at the button a model finds there, only once the person allows it

rule_parameters.description: each rule parameter the family's code implements: what it means and the values a profile may give it (a JSON schema); the standard values are the core's DEFAULT_RULES, and a profile may set only these parameters, within these values

goal_value.description: what a reach_value goal's number counts in this family's games (the rules judge it): the value a request in words may set a target for

default_compute.description: boards the default policy evaluates per move when a task asks in words and names no budget: what played its registered sites within the per-move time measured in plan §13

verify_every.description: how many moves between checks against the screen; 1 in the first families

discovery.description: how a game of this family with no registered profile is set up from one look (plan §4.5): the rule values its code plays, read off the board, and the controls, settling and colour tolerance a session profile starts from; a family without it plays registered profiles only

rules.description: each rule parameter a look may set, with the least value the family's code plays (and the most, where its code has one: a board's size has none)

controls.description: the controls a session profile tries first, as a profile registers them

settling.description: the settling a session profile starts with, as a profile registers it
